common: Create ONE landscape photorealistic historical royal character reference sheet, speculative artistic reconstruction of a Salastambha dynasty king of ancient Kamarupa. References 1 Tiwa, 2 Rabha, 3 Motok are clothing inspiration only; never copy their dhoti, modern shoes, plastic buttons, props or faces. Reference 4 is sheet layout and realism standard only, do NOT clone its face or costume. Distinct believable Northeast Indian human face specified below, natural brown skin with pores, real fabric fibres, dignified royal presence, modest gold earrings, neck ornament and bracelets, barefoot. NO cartoon, illustration finish, CGI, wax skin, fantasy armour or European crown. NO DHOTI: lower garment is a straight overlapping knee-length lungi with continuous skirt-like hem, no between-leg tuck, no divided trouser legs or balloon folds. Shirts cover both shoulders unless explicitly sleeveless, cloth ties and hidden overlap only, no plastic buttons, button rows, pockets or zips. EMPTY HANDS, no flute, basket, staff, weapon. Soft cool-grey studio background. EXACT sheet arrangement: top 60% FOUR FULL BODY VIEWS left to right FRONT, LEFT PROFILE (nose MUST point LEFT toward left edge of image, whole body side on), BACK, THREE-QUARTER (nose points right). Bottom 35% FOUR LARGE HEAD-AND-SHOULDERS studies FACE CLOSE-UP, RIGHT PROFILE (nose points RIGHT), LOW ANGLE (camera looking UP at chin), HIGH ANGLE (camera looking DOWN at face). Consistent identity and costume in all eight views. Clear small view captions, name heading top left with CHARACTER REFERENCE. Footer ARTISTIC RECONSTRUCTION · REVIEW DRAFT. Generous margins, full bodies head to toe, headgear uncropped. Do not repeat eight full-body turnarounds; bottom row is portraits.
